description: The minimum runtime and compiler requirements for Next.js 16, aligned with Node.js Active LTS and Maintenance LTS stages and modern async Server Component type checking.
The official CLI tool that automates AST transformations such as awaiting async request APIs (next-async-request-api) and migrating middleware.ts to proxy.ts (middleware-to-proxy).
The two-argument revalidateTag API performs stale-while-revalidate invalidation using a cacheLife profile, whereas updateTag immediately expires cached data inside Server Actions.
A custom next.config.ts adapter that externalizes Next.js cache storage to a shared store like Redis so multiple self-hosted container replicas share invalidation events.
A next.config.ts setting that disables per-process in-memory LRU caching so multi-replica containers always read and invalidate through the shared external cacheHandler.
